name: ACCESS
funding: NSF-funded coordination + separately funded resource providers
route: ACCESS project request; exchange credits for provider resources
fit: Broad CPU/GPU research and instruction; resource discovery and support.
boundary: Provider quotas, scheduling, allocation term and software vary. Counts overlap with participating resource providers.

name: OSG Open Science Pool (OSPool)
route: Documented guest education notebook or facilitated full event accounts
fit: Independent text/image analyses, parameter sweeps, model evaluation and many short CPU/GPU jobs.
boundary: Guest four-hour timeout/files may be lost; full accounts usually end shortly after event. Interruptible fair share; complete/checkpoint jobs within 20 hours. No sensitive/proprietary data or classroom GPU reservation.

name: PATh Facility
route: Consult PATh; NSF-funded project startup/credit process
fit: Dedicated throughput research jobs when the affiliated NSF program and credits are confirmed.
boundary: IDSS is not explicitly listed in the published affiliated-program policy. MESA funding alone does not establish eligibility or course authorization; confirm with PATh/NSF. Separate from OSPool education access.

name: NRP / Nautilus
route: Institutional onboarding; hosted JupyterHub, API or project namespace
fit: Hosted teaching notebooks, GPUs, open-weight model APIs and containerized services.
boundary: Hosted hub starts with 5 GB homes; larger storage, class/GPU quota and hub-specific exceptions need approval. Ordinary-pod six-hour rules do not establish every hub limit. Not archival storage; idle volumes may be purged.

name: Jetstream2
route: ACCESS allocation, course images and student/project access
fit: Notebooks, RStudio, desktops, web/database teaching servers and vGPU environments.
boundary: Always-on VM accounting, separate GPU exchange, concurrent quota and extra storage need approval. Independent backups required. Expiry/overdraw disables access and can destroy unresolved resources after thirty days.

name: NAIRR / NAIRR Classroom
route: Appropriate researcher or Classroom request
fit: AI coursework, GPUs, model/data/tools and selected managed environments.
boundary: US-based class eligibility and approved resources; instructor/TA support expected. Research and Classroom requests differ; partner offerings are not all federally purchased.

name: CloudBank / CloudBank Classroom
kind: Commercial-cloud broker and managed teaching platform
route: General ACCESS Explore Classroom route; separate NAIRR Classroom route for AI coursework
fit: Managed Python/R/C++ browser environments with login and student storage.
boundary: Managed CPU per-student limits/capacity need confirmation. Current registry says fall 2026 GPU pilot is at capacity; requests considered in 2027, not guaranteed. Renewal terms need reconciliation with education-period policy.

name: Chameleon / CHI@Edge
route: Eligible PI project; allocation and resource lease
fit: Systems/MLOps, edge/IoT, bare-metal experiments, specialized GPU/FPGA hardware.
boundary: Experiment purpose, SU budget and short hardware leases. No unrestricted production hosting; student membership normally follows PI approval.

name: CloudLab
route: Approved project with planned class reservations
fit: Distributed systems, reproducible root-access labs and networked application experiments.
boundary: Use only while actively experimenting; node data disappears at termination. Reserve for deadline bursts and export work.

name: FABRIC
route: Project and experimental resource slices
fit: Distributed AI, edge workloads, streaming/data movement and instrument-to-compute experiments.
boundary: Experiment should need the network/testbed capabilities; not a stand-alone generic GPU account or production campus server.

name: NSF NCAR Derecho / analysis resources
route: Classroom/workshop or qualifying research allocation
fit: Earth-system, environmental and geospatial data/AI instruction with consulting.
boundary: Earth-system mission fit; setup lead time, accounts, dates and reservations required. Separate grant not required for eligible classes.

name: DOE NERSC / ALCF / OLCF
route: ALCC, INCITE or facility-specific merit request
fit: Large mission-aligned scientific simulation, data analysis and AI research.
boundary: ALCC does not require DOE sponsorship, but merit/mission/scaling requirements apply. Not the default for everyday college labs.

name: NASA High-End Computing
route: NASA-sponsored project / mission request process
fit: NASA-aligned Earth/space/engineering computing.
boundary: Sponsorship and mission/award review required; not a general open classroom resource.

name: NIH AnVIL / Terra ecosystem
funding: NIH NHGRI platform funding; cloud usage billed separately
route: Project/data authorization plus cloud billing or awarded credits
fit: Genomic data-science notebooks, workflows and reproducible biomedical training.
boundary: Free platform browsing does not mean free compute/storage/egress. NIH AnVIL differs from Purdue ACCESS Anvil; old credit calls are not current offers.

name: CyVerse Discovery Environment / VICE
kind: Managed applications and scientific data platform
funding: Historical core NSF support; new project funding + subscriptions + Arizona TRIF
status: Mixed funding; current published UArizona benefit
route: Basic account; confirm institutional Pro or collaboration access
fit: Python/R apps, data management and a practical UArizona course/pilot route.
boundary: Basic 200 units/year, 5 GB, one job and no sharing/public links. Published UArizona free Pro is state-funded, not universal; GPU and class access need consultation.

name: Open Storage Network
funding: NSF seed support + participating storage operators
route: Separate storage request through ACCESS; provider capacity
fit: Large actively used teaching/research datasets and portable object storage.
boundary: Documented request range 10–50 TB; not CPU time, backup or archival permanence. Actual size/site capacity needs verification.

name: OSDF / Pelican
parent: OSG data layer; interoperates with OSPool / OSN
route: Connect existing store or allocated OSN/CC* storage through OSG
fit: Deliver data to distributed jobs, notebooks and scientific applications.
boundary: Not another storage or compute award. Backing store/access policy required; not for highly regulated/PII/HIPAA data; preservation is separate.

name: MESA
funding: NSF IDSS; project site cites award 2632685
status: Funded expansion; published portal/tools, readiness untested
route: Published MESA portal/docs; underlying services govern compute
fit: Metadata, semantic discovery, reproducible data/agent workflows, Jupyter/R/desktop app layer.
boundary: Portal reads the existing CyVerse account/teams/quota; it does not add a second allowance. Selected apps, Save & Exit, per-user Pro/TRIF entitlement, classroom/GPU capacity and support remain to be tested.

name: National Data Platform (NDP)
route: Public catalog/education activity; consult NDP for class workspace
fit: Discoverable compute-ready instructional data, reusable AI activities and capstone content.
boundary: Some homepage features are forthcoming. Confirm available workspaces, quota, onboarding and underlying compute rather than equating an IDSS grant with a user allocation.

name: Fabric for AI-Driven Science (FabAID)
status: Funded deployment; service-specific terms to confirm
route: Project service endpoints/consultation
fit: Storage federation, cache/delivery, transformation, discovery and data-intensive workflows.
boundary: Data-service integration complements compute allocations; no universal GPU entitlement, class quota or archival guarantee established.

name: Interactive Discovery Laboratory (iDLab)
route: Project consultation; existing site account/allocations as required
fit: Browser applications, interactive workspaces and cross-site data/workflow access.
boundary: Participating sites retain policies/control. Gateway access is not an extra copy of the sites’ capacity or long-term archives; course readiness must be confirmed.

name: BRIDGE National Center / Apache Texera
route: Project collaboration or own supported platform deployment
fit: Visual/no-code workflows, reproducible social-science/data analyses and shared community models.
boundary: May require your own host/cloud/resources and operators. No verified no-cost public compute subscription or guaranteed class capacity.

name: National Science Data Fabric (NSDF)
route: Project contact; NSF announcement verifies expansion scope
fit: Standardized scientific data discovery/access, reproducibility and data/AI workforce development.
boundary: Funding/intent verified from NSF announcement; current user-specific access terms, compute quota and production readiness not established in this review.

name: Open OnDemand + JupyterHub / BinderHub
funding: Open OnDemand federal-supported development; site funds operation
route: Use provider-installed portal or deploy on approved compute
fit: Notebooks, RStudio, VS Code, remote desktops and visual/science gateways.
boundary: Software is not hardware/time allocation. Only Open OnDemand’s funding is evidenced here; no claim that every JupyterHub installation is federally funded. Operators and backing resources remain necessary.

name: Pegasus / HTCondor / ACCESS Pegasus
kind: Workflow orchestration and job execution products
route: Hosted ACCESS Pegasus with active allocation; OSG/PATh tools
fit: Portable multi-step pipelines, task sweeps, data staging and transparent execution.
boundary: Uses existing allocations/pools; does not create another pool. Software portability is not data preservation or a substitute for operations.

name: CILogon / Globus
kind: Identity, authorization and research data movement
funding: Historical federal development/integration; current operations include subscriptions
route: Institution/provider identity configuration and endpoint support
fit: Campus login, role-based access, data transfer and cross-site workflow connections.
boundary: Basic services may be free while advanced support/sharing costs. Neither supplies a compute/storage allocation; CILogon says operations shifted to subscriptions in 2019.

name: Science gateways / SGX3
funding: NSF-funded SGX3; substantial operations can be client-funded
route: Gateway consultation/community resources; project-specific gateway accounts
fit: Usable domain applications and teaching interfaces beyond raw HPC command lines.
boundary: Limited funded planning/UX/training differs from paid development/hosting/operations. A gateway catalog is not a universal free app-hosting plan.

name: IDSS program
kind: Operator grant program, not a compute account
route: Institutional proposal / funded project collaboration
fit: National data-service development, transition to operations and planning.
boundary: Six named 2026 projects have different services/stages; the grant does not award every instructor CPU/GPU hours.

name: Campus Cyberinfrastructure (CC*)
status: Program; current page awaiting new publication
route: Institutional funding process; actual local award/service rules
fit: Campus compute, networking, data storage/digital archives and integration.
boundary: Current page has no upcoming due dates and awaits new guidelines. Not an open national classroom account; sharing, operation and stewardship have to be funded.

name: Major Research Instrumentation (MRI)
route: Institutional limited-submission/award process
fit: Appropriate shared instrumentation and computing-linked research training.
boundary: Current solicitation, instrument eligibility and campus proposal limits matter. A funding route is not a ready device/GPU account; this map does not assert an open submission window.

name: State / Regional AI Infrastructure Hubs
funding: NSF pays coordination/workforce/education; partners pay infrastructure
route: Institution/state/regional consortium; actual award and resource terms
fit: Faculty course development, facilitators, shared AI-service coordination and regional scale.
boundary: NSF does not acquire/fund the compute infrastructure under this solicitation. Partners must sustain it; no awarded Arizona hub is verified here.

name: SCIPE / CyberTraining / ACCESS facilitation
route: Existing facilitator/training services or institutional grant pathway
fit: Support ownership, instructor onboarding, reusable course materials and train-the-trainer capacity.
boundary: Grant programs do not promise staff for every instructor. Current call status and actual support agreements must be checked; college effort is still required.
